Real Upwork MCP response samples captured 2026-11-06 (personal data replaced).
Facts seen:
- Money fields are strings like "$13,692.95". Parse them.
- Many fields can be missing (client with no spend/rating, hourly with "no rate stated", no budget).
- Text from clients is wrapped in <untrusted_participant_content> tags.
- get_job: client_record has spend_total (string) and hours_total; 13692.95/1542 = 8.88 -> LOW. Has a 1-star review -> red flag. connects_cost 17 > connects_balance 3 -> red flag.
- get_job has can_apply, plan, bid_stats_available, preferred_qualifications, screening_questions.
- find_jobs args: action + org_uid + params {mode, days_posted, verified_payment_only, limit}; get uses params {job_id}.
- smart_search_best_match.json: hourly budget is the `budget` string "$15.00–$35.00/hr" (en dash). `hourly_budget_type` values seen: "client-specified range", "platform default range" (Upwork's default, NOT the client's real rate), "no rate stated". Also a `premium` flag.
- get_profile.json (action get): title/description/skills under data.personalData + data.skills; rate data.personalData.chargeRate.rawValue; profileAggregates (top_rated, totalEarnings, totalFeedback, totalJobs). No JSS field here. Text fields wrapped in untrusted tags even for own profile.
- Captured 2026-11-06 (R3/X samples, anonymized; real IDs replaced):
  - list_proposals.json (`list_freelancer_proposals list`): data.vendorProposals.edges[].node {id, auditDetails.createdDateTime.displayValue, boosted, terms.connectsBid (only when boosted), marketplaceJobPosting{id,content.title,url}, status{status,status_label}, terms.chargeRate.rawValue, viewedByClient}. "Accepted" = submitted. Default list shows only Accepted; other statuses: Offered, Hired, Declined, Withdrawn, Archived, Activated, Pending. Max limit 25, cursor = pageInfo.endCursor.
  - get_proposal.json (`get`, params {id}): data.vendorProposal adds proposalCoverLetter (string, NOT wrapped) and questionsAnswers[]{question (wrapped in untrusted tags), answer (not wrapped)}. insights_available false on Freelancer Basic.
  - invitations_empty.json (`invitations`): data.invitations[] (each has id = invitation_uid, jobPosting{id,title}), totalCount. Real account had 0.
  - freelancer_dashboard.json (`get_freelancer_dashboard check`): data.connects.balance.connectsBalance, data.invitations{count,items}, data.offers{count,items}, data.messages.rooms[] (awaiting_reply_from you/them), data.active_contracts, data.identity_verification, data.matching_jobs (preview). No JSS and no profile views here.
  - find_freelancers_search.json (`find_freelancers search`, params {query, limit, offset}): freelancers[]{person_id, profile_key, name, job_success_score, top_rated, total_earnings (bucket), boosted (paid ad)}, hasMore, next_offset. Rank = position across pages (offset). My profile is found by profile_key (get_profile gives own key / person id). Max limit 25.
  - find_freelancers_get_profile.json: SHAPE GUESSED, NOT CAPTURED. Written by hand (plan X1) for `find_freelancers action=get_profile params {profile_key}`. The live answer has not been seen; the real one may differ. `app/metrics.py` looks for a `job_success_score` (also `jobSuccessScore`) anywhere in the answer and stores NULL when it finds none. Own profile key comes from `get_profile get`: data.identity.ciphertext (starts with `~`).
  - invitations_two.json: SHAPE FROM TOOL HELP, NOT CAPTURED. Written by hand (plan X3) with 2 invitations for `list_freelancer_proposals invitations` (same shape as invitations_empty.json: data.invitations[] with id = invitation_uid and jobPosting{id,title}; the first title carries the untrusted tags on purpose). The live account had 0 invitations. `app/metrics.py` reads the same item shape from `get_freelancer_dashboard` data.invitations.items (also NOT seen with items yet); a flat job_id / title is read as well.
  - proposal_preview.json: SHAPE FROM TOOL HELP, NOT CAPTURED. Written by hand (plan H1) for the answer of `manage_proposals create` (preview step): preview_id, connects_cost, connects_balance, can_apply, bid stats (or bid_stats_available false + note), boost {available, reason, current_top_bids, current_top_bids_available, recommended_connects, max_boost_connects, recommendation, note}, unmet_preferred_qualifications, additional_preferences. No real preview was made. `app/upwork/writes.py` looks the keys up anywhere in the answer, so a different nesting still works; a missing preview_id makes the preview "failed".
  - get_messages_rooms.json: SHAPE GUESSED, NOT CAPTURED. Written by hand (plan H3) for `get_messages action=list_rooms params {limit}` (the action name and arguments are a guess too). The room items copy the captured `data.messages.rooms[]` of freelancer_dashboard.json (id, topic, awaiting_reply_from, numUnread, createdAtDateTime, latestStory{from, message, createdDateTime}), put under data.rooms. `app/inbox.py` looks for a list called `rooms` anywhere in the answer. The real answer may differ.
